desc:
Escape the Crazy High School! 🏫 

Something’s seriously wrong in this school!
The teachers have gone crazy, the hallways and classrooms are filled with deadly traps, and the principal Mr. Maldorf wants to keep us trapped in his high school FOREVER!
Our mission is to survive all the crazy obstacles and find a way to escape this insane school once and for all!!!

🎁 Join our Group to get inside the Group Only Room: https://www.roblox.com/communities/733149460/Gin-Creations#!/about

👍 If you enjoyed the obby, please leave a like and favorite, it helps a lot! ⭐️
